longTitle.officialTitle: To modify the boundary of the Rocky Mountain National Park, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Rocky Mountain National Park Boundary Modification Act”.

paragraph.heading: Map.—
paragraph.content: The term “map” means the map entitled “Rocky Mountain National Park Proposed Boundary Revision”, numbered 121/154,327, and dated June 2019.

paragraph.heading: Non-federal land.—
paragraph.content: The term “non-Federal land” means the approximately 40 acres of non-Federal land depicted as “TR 05-133” on the map.

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

section.heading: ROCKY MOUNTAIN NATIONAL PARK BOUNDARY MODIFICATION.

subsection.heading: Land Acquisition.—
subsection.content: The Secretary may acquire, by donation, the non-Federal land for inclusion in the Rocky Mountain National Park.

subsection.heading: Boundary Modification.—
subsection.chapeau: On acquisition of the non-Federal land under subsection (a), the Secretary shall—

paragraph.content: modify the boundary of the Rocky Mountain National Park to include the acquisition; and
administer the acquired land as part of the Rocky Mountain National Park, in accordance with applicable laws.

subsection.heading: Availability of Map.—
subsection.content: The map shall be on file and available for public inspection in appropriate offices of the National Park Service.
